description.value: Little Bangkok is a Thai fast-food counter in downtown Vancouver, formerly operating as Wow Thai Food. It serves a wide range of Thai classics — Pad Thai, Khao Soi, papaya salad, chicken satay, and mango sticky rice — with online ordering and pickup available. Sitting in the heart of the central business district on West Pender, it makes a convenient and flavourful refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the city core.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 45m; rack at 49m; rack at 67m; stands (5 spaces) at 78m; stands (2 spaces) at 80m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m. Total: 9 spaces.

Vegetarian-friendly is confirmed by a menu item label ('Vegeterian-freindly' on Spring Rolls); no evidence found for bike parking, washrooms, or water refill.
